title: Native IFC/openBIM interoperability on the verified CAD/BIM product
objective: Turn the already-earned RESEARCH-CAD-003 semantic evidence into the first production IFC/openBIM interoperability workflow on the verified CAD/BIM product, without making IfcOpenShell or IFC files canonical: Offisos BIM -> IFC export -> external IFC -> IFC import -> semantic reconciliation -> canonical Offisos BIM -> Construction Graph.
acceptance_criteria: A representative Offisos BIM model exports to IFC with required semantic classes/properties/relationships preserved.
A representative IFC model imports into canonical Offisos BIM elements with stable canonical IDs and IFC GlobalIds retained only as provenance.
Export -> import semantic comparison reports supported-field preservation and explicit LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED results.
Units and placements survive the round trip with declared tolerances.
Controlled model mutations survive the IFC round trip and identify exactly which canonical elements changed.
IDS validation can be invoked through the supported IfcTester toolchain with failures represented explicitly and bound to canonical provenance.
BCF topic/reference contracts bind issues to canonical element provenance without making BCF the system of record.
Web and Electron produce equivalent semantic results through the shared App API.
Existing CAD, BIM, documentation, Graph and real-engine suites remain green.
No direct IfcOpenShell imports occur in renderer/CADDocument/App API; IFC engine work remains inside adapter/worker boundaries.
IFC version/file provenance and deterministic import records are persisted.
No protected architecture files are modified.
non_goals: IFC4x3 parity beyond the explicitly supported subset.
Native IFC editing UI for every schema entity.
Making IFC or IfcOpenShell the canonical model or Construction Graph.
Approval or verification claim by implementation.
risk_assumptions: Issue #47 and execution release comment 5434489016 are authoritative.
RESEARCH-CAD-003 is consumed as verified semantic/toolchain evidence and remains outside the declared dependency list.
Pre-existing architect-side debt: COMPAT-CAD-001 record remains PR_OPEN on main.
Toolchain pins follow RESEARCH-CAD-003: ifcopenshell==0.8.5, IfcTester==0.8.5, numpy==2.1.3; known broken PyPI distributions are excluded.
Deterministic export uses fixed header data, stable creation order, deterministic IfcGuid derivation and canonical semantic IR hashing.
Import fidelity is explicit: unsupported or missing source data is classified LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED and any approximation is caller-declared.
Geometry fidelity is limited to the supported research-proven representation recipes; arbitrary external geometry is classified UNSUPPORTED.

evidence.description: 312/312 app tests on the real toolchains at implementation head, including 28 deterministic IFC tests covering identity, deterministic export, import/reconciliation, geometry reconstruction, mutations, undo, persistence, IDS, BCF, host parity, and LOCK-018 IFC boundaries.
Deployable Web and Electron host proofs on implementation head, including deterministic IFC export/import, semantic reconciliation, IDS/BCF, persistence and BrowserWindow smoke evidence.
All PR-head CI workflows green on implementation head 1a92b3d, including compat-ifc-001, governance, and all regression workflows.

Post-merge verification evidence bound to the exact COMPAT-IFC-001 merge commit 31b3e9f. Governance push workflow #110 (id 33074200308) completed successfully on the merged tree; the merged tree is the exact merge of the previously reviewed PR #49 head.

decisions.rationale: Architect post-merge verification of COMPAT-IFC-001 against merge commit 31b3e9f; PR #49 was previously approved and merged, and post-merge governance evidence is green.
